summary.text: Mellissa Heermann is a Republican state representative from South Dakota House District 7 who assumed office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She has worked as a revenue cycle director at the Brookings Health System and has served on the Brookings school board.

paragraphs.text: Mellissa Heermann earned a bachelor's degree in international business/trade/commerce from the University of Nebraska at Lincoln and a master's degree in operations management and supervision from South Dakota State University in 2020.
Her career experience includes work as revenue cycle director of the Brookings Health System, an IT manager with Daktronics, and a project manager in mentorship with Florence Crittenton.
She has served on the school board of the Brookings School District and on the board of the Brookings County Youth Mentoring Program.
Heermann assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 10, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session she is assigned to the House Education Committee and the House Local Government Committee.
